edits.old: Context may resolve the meanings and references of selected expressions, but must not supply a part of the subject that the mask does not express.

3. Construct the mask. If "expressible" is true, select all wording that contributes to expressing the target in its original context, including repeated contributions. Sharing a word or concept with the target is not sufficient. Keep the required details and relationships; exclude added meaning and specificity. Individual fragments need not express the whole subject; the complete mask must. Include meaningful parts of words and hashtags by the same standard. Fragments need not form grammatical prose. If "expressible" is false, return an empty "mask" array.
edits.new: 3. Construct the mask. If "expressible" is true, choose fragments for the meaning they contribute to the target in the full note. Use the relationships already established in the note to connect those meanings; do not select additional wording just to make a connection explicit if it adds meaning the target does not require. Keep the target's required details and relationships and exclude added meaning and specificity. Include all contributions to the target, including repetitions; sharing a word or concept with the target is not sufficient. Individual fragments need not express the whole subject; the complete mask must. Include meaningful parts of words and hashtags by the same standard. Fragments need not form grammatical prose. If "expressible" is false, return an empty "mask" array.
